name: Inactivity rates of adults, by educational attainment, age group, gender, country of birth and age at migration
description:
This dataset contains data on inactivity rates by educational attainment level, migration status, age group and gender. The default table displays 2023 data (or the latest available year) on the inactivity rates of native- and foreign-born 25-64 year-olds with below upper secondary, upper secondary or post-secondary non-tertiary, or tertiary attainment. The selection can be changed to display data by more detailed educational attainment level, by program orientation, by age at migration, by gender and by age group. Filter the time period to display historical data.

For more information, please consult the Education at a Glance web page and the OECD Handbook for Internationally Comparative Education Statistics: Concepts, Standards, Definitions and Classifications.
